packageRules.description: Group non-major Cargo updates into one PR.
dtolnay/rust-toolchain versions by BRANCH (1.97.0), not tag — the github-actions manager can't track it. The custom manager below tracks the @<ver> ref as a Rust release instead.
Keep every Rust-version pin in lockstep, in ONE PR: rust-toolchain.toml, the rust:* build image, and the dtolnay/rust-toolchain CI action are all surfaced as depName 'rust'.

customManagers.description: rust-toolchain.toml channel — tracked as a Rust release under depName 'rust'.
dtolnay/rust-toolchain CI action ref — tracked as a Rust release under depName 'rust' so it bumps WITH the toolchain.
Dockerfile RUST_VERSION ARG — tracked as a Rust release under depName 'rust'.
